newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN THURSDAY TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN THURSDAY TRADE.

text.p: Zimbabwe's short-term trading rates were quoted mixed in Thursday's liquid market, dealers said.

The market opened up Z$56.5 million and with another surplus of Z$282.5 million forecast for the end of the day, the central Reserve Bank auctioned 91-day treasury bills worth Z$200 million to discount houses at 24.8 percent.
The central bank bills were also being sold on the secondary market at a steady 24.65 percent as were call bills at 22 percent.

NCDs with maturity of 30, 60 and 90 days were being bought unchanged at 26 percent but sold firmer at 25.75 from 25 percent while bankers acceptance bills were stable at 25.5 percent (buying) but slightly up at 24.75 percent from 24.7 percent on the selling side.
